chain.title: The Read Me
chain.desc: Paper and redstone. The One Probe ships its own instruction note as a craftable item, which is the only documentation the mod gives you in game.

chain.title: Build The Probe
chain.desc: A comparator, a gold nugget and redstone on the diagonal. Hold the probe and every block and mob you look at reports its name, contents, energy, growth stage and health.

chain.title: Wear It, Iron
chain.desc: An iron helmet and a probe on the mod's own theoneprobe:probe_helmet recipe type. It frees your hand: the readout works while the probe is on your head.

chain.title: Wear It, Gold
chain.desc: The same one-step upgrade applied to a golden helmet. The probe transfers to whichever helmet you actually want to wear.

chain.title: Wear It, Diamond
chain.desc: The last of the three. From here the probe costs you nothing - no slot, no durability, no toggle - which is the state the mod is designed to end in.

notes: WHY THIS UTILITY MOD GOT A CHAIN AND THE OTHER TWELVE DID NOT: The One Probe is the single exception in the utility audit. It registers 7 items and ships 6 recipes in data/theoneprobe/recipes, so it has a real, short, craftable progression rather than being pure HUD. Every id here is confirmed by an item model at assets/theoneprobe/models/item/<id>.json, an item.theoneprobe.<id> lang key, and a recipe whose result is that id. No widening was needed - this mod names its items with item.* keys, so the strict intersection is correct and gives all 7. OBTAINABILITY, and the reason only 5 of the 7 are chained. theoneprobe:creativeprobe has an item model and a lang key ('The Creative Probe') but NO recipe and NO loot table anywhere in the jar - it is a creative-mode tool and is dropped. theoneprobe:probe_goggles is the important one and it is exactly the conditional trap: data/theoneprobe/recipes/probegoggles.json carries "conditions": [{"type": "forge:mod_loaded", "modid": "baubles"}]. Baubles does not exist on 1.20.1 - Curios replaced it - so that condition can never be satisfied in this pack. The recipe is also written as "type": "forge:ore_shaped" with a "forge:ore_dict" key of "nuggetGold", which are 1.12-era serialisers that no longer exist in 1.20.1, so the recipe would fail to parse even if Baubles were somehow present. The item registers regardless, which is precisely why a generator scanning the item registry would offer it as a quest that can never be completed. It is dropped, and this is the only forge-condition-gated item found across all thirteen mods in the utility audit. The remaining five are unconditional: probe.json and probenote.json are plain minecraft:crafting_shaped, and the three helmet probes use the mod's own theoneprobe:probe_helmet recipe type, which takes a vanilla helmet plus theoneprobe:probe. NO COLLECTIONS: five obtainable items is not enough to fill a wheel of five without simply repeating the spine, and the three helmet probes are a variant family of three, below the minimum wheel size. The collections key is therefore omitted, as it is in twelve other files in this directory. See moddb/chains_research/_utility_audit.json for the other twelve mods, all of which are correctly excluded from chapter generation.
